'''Farasa Anturi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Anturi was a deranged [[Prince/Legends|princess]] from [[House Picutorion|House Anturi]], an aristocratic family that was based in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]]. In [[553 BBY]], she married the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Osted Picutorion]] and her house was renamed "House Picutorion", after him. Their marriage instigated a conflict known as the [[Crimson Days]] between House Picutorion and the rival Senex houses [[House Vandron]] and [[House Petro]], which was ended when the [[Third Nantama Synod]] accepted Anturi's marriage to Picutorion.<ref name="TEA" />
